title: Hibp Metric2 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hibp:metric2
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day hibp metric2 (2) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on hibp metric2 (2) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It scores what time of day your hibp metric2 (2) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
